title: Covariance of a regular correlated pair sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $a_0,\ldots,a_{n-1}\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $\sum_i a_i^2=1$. Choose a sign vector uniformly and, independently in each coordinate, retain its sign with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and otherwise flip it; form the pair sum whose $i$th contribution is $(a_i X_i,a_i Y_i)$. For all $x,y\in\mathbb R^2$, the covariance bilinear form of this random pair sum satisfies $\operatorname{Cov}(x,y)=x^{\mathsf T}\begin{pmatrix}1&\rho\\\rho&1\end{pmatrix}y$.
